Here is your updated `index.html` with both `<noscript>` handling and a boot-time `error` / `unhandledrejection` reporter:

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
    <title>Terlingua Magazine</title>
    <base href="/" />
    <link rel="preload" id="webassembly" />
    <link rel="alternate" type="application/rss+xml" title="Terlingua Magazine RSS" href="/feed.xml" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/app.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="ObserverMagazine.Web.styles.css" />
    <script type="importmap"></script>
    <noscript>
        <style>.app-loading { display: none; }</style>
    </noscript>
</head>
<body>
    <div id="app">
        <p class="app-loading">Loading Terlingua Magazine…</p>
        <noscript>
            <div style="max-width: 38rem; margin: 2rem auto; padding: 1rem 1.25rem; border: 1px solid #d0d7de; border-radius: 6px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; line-height: 1.5;">
                <strong>JavaScript is required</strong>
                <p style="margin: 0.5rem 0 0;">Terlingua Magazine runs in the browser using WebAssembly and requires JavaScript to be enabled.</p>
            </div>
        </noscript>
    </div>

    <div id="blazor-error-ui">
        An unhandled error has occurred.
        <a href="." class="reload">Reload</a>
        <span class="dismiss">🗙</span>
    </div>

    <script>
        (function () {
            function showBootError(label, detail) {
                var app = document.getElementById('app');
                if (!app) return;

                var loading = app.querySelector('.app-loading');
                var box = document.getElementById('boot-error');

                // Once Blazor mounts and removes .app-loading (with no active boot error),
                // step aside and let #blazor-error-ui handle post-boot runtime errors.
                if (!loading && !box) return;

                if (!box) {
                    if (loading && loading.parentNode) {
                        loading.parentNode.removeChild(loading);
                    }
                    box = document.createElement('div');
                    box.id = 'boot-error';
                    box.setAttribute('role', 'alert');
                    box.style.cssText = 'max-width:42rem;margin:2rem auto;padding:1rem 1.25rem;border:1px solid #cf222e;border-radius:6px;background:#fff8f8;color:#24292f;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;line-height:1.5;';

                    var heading = document.createElement('strong');
                    heading.textContent = 'Unable to start Terlingua Magazine in this browser';
                    box.appendChild(heading);

                    var note = document.createElement('p');
                    note.style.cssText = 'margin:0.4rem 0 0.75rem;font-size:0.95rem;';
                    note.textContent = 'This site targets current evergreen browsers without legacy shims.';
                    box.appendChild(note);

                    var log = document.createElement('pre');
                    log.id = 'boot-error-log';
                    log.style.cssText = 'margin:0;padding:0.75rem;background:#f6f8fa;border-radius:4px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-word;font-size:0.85rem;';
                    box.appendChild(log);

                    app.appendChild(box);
                }

                var logEl = document.getElementById('boot-error-log');
                if (logEl) {
                    var line = '[' + label + '] ' + detail;
                    logEl.textContent = logEl.textContent ? (logEl.textContent + '\n' + line) : line;
                }
            }

            function formatError(err) {
                if (!err) return 'Unknown error';
                if (typeof err === 'string') return err;
                if (err.message) return (err.name ? err.name + ': ' : '') + err.message;
                try { return String(err); } catch (e) { return 'Unserializable error'; }
            }

            window.addEventListener('error', function (event) {
                if (event && event.target && event.target !== window) {
                    var src = event.target.src || event.target.href || event.target.tagName;
                    showBootError('resource error', 'Failed to load ' + src);
                    return;
                }

                var msg = (event && event.message) ? event.message : formatError(event && event.error);
                var loc = (event && event.filename)
                    ? ' (' + event.filename + ':' + event.lineno + ':' + event.colno + ')'
                    : '';
                showBootError('error', msg + loc);
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection', function (event) {
                showBootError('unhandledrejection', formatError(event && event.reason));
            });
        })();
    </script>
    <script src="_framework/blazor.webassembly#[.{fingerprint}].js"></script>
</body>
</html>
```

### A few subtle details built into this:
* **Deliberately written in ES5 (`var`, `function`) and placed *before* `blazor.webassembly.js`:** Even if an old browser chokes on ES2022+ syntax inside Blazor or your JS modules, the diagnostic script itself will still parse and run.
* **Capture-phase `error` + `unhandledrejection`:** Passing `true` to `addEventListener('error', ..., true)` catches failed `<script>` / module loads in addition to syntax/runtime errors, while `unhandledrejection` catches async WebAssembly instantiation and `import()` failures.
* **Self-retiring once booted:** Once Blazor replaces `.app-loading` with your rendered app, the listener stops modifying `#app` so post-boot errors continue going to `#blazor-error-ui` as usual.
* **Clean `<noscript>` state:** The `<noscript><style>.app-loading { display: none; }</style></noscript>` in `<head>` hides the "Loading…" text when JavaScript is turned off so users only see the `<noscript>` message.
* **Inline fallback styling:** If `app.css` uses modern CSS features that an older mobile browser ignores, the error box still renders cleanly.

When you load this on the iPhone 8 Plus and Nexus 6, it should immediately print the exact line or WebAssembly/module rejection that halted boot.
